A little about me

Ideas into
impact.

A media student with a hands-on approach to creating, planning and communicating stories across digital platforms.

I’m an ambitious Journalism and Mass Communication (BAJMC) undergraduate seeking opportunities in the media industry, with a keen interest in social media management and digital strategy.

I combine organisational abilities, practical content-creation skills and a foundation in media studies to help build audience engagement across editorial, production and digital communication work.

Alongside client projects, I continue to develop my own freelance visual brand, Nshares, where I explore cinematic perspectives and visual storytelling.
